summary: Sandbach United are gearing up for an exciting 2026/27 season with just a week to go, having welcomed several new signings and one returning player to bolster the squad. The Ramblers recently faced St Helens in a competitive pre-season clash, with their opponents' clinical finishing making the difference in a well-fought encounter. With three new kits on display and a quest for promotion ahead, the club is actively seeking sponsorship partners to support their campaign.
